verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's own docs let you register a webhook URL as an alert recipient for project error alerts (triggered by error frequency) and for uptime-monitor failures. These are product-native outbound HTTP callbacks, but the subscribable events are limited to alerts, and payloads and delivery semantics are undocumented. Missing for 10: broad event-type subscriptions (e.g., issue resolved/assigned, releases), documented payload schema, signing/retry semantics, programmatic webhook registration via API, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: By default, new project alerts send emails to a project's team members, but you can also add a webhook URL by clicking “Add An Alert Recipient.”
Here you can specify when you want to receive alerts based on the frequency of errors.
If GlitchTip doesn't receive your ping, it will send you an alert via email or webhook.
